# MapVGL

`mapvgl-beta188.min.js` is the unmodified MapVGL 1.0.0-beta.188 distribution from Baidu's documented CDN:

https://code.bdstatic.com/npm/mapvgl@1.0.0-beta.188/dist/mapvgl.min.js

The published package metadata declares license `ISC`. Package metadata: https://code.bdstatic.com/npm/mapvgl@1.0.0-beta.188/package.json

Official HeatmapLayer reference: https://mapv.baidu.com/gl/docs/HeatmapLayer.html

Pinned locally for predictable loading; the application does not alter the vendor source.

# Apache ECharts

Unmodified Apache ECharts 6.0.0 full distribution: echarts-6.0.0.min.js. Apache License 2.0; upstream license and notice retained in ECHARTS-LICENSE / ECHARTS-NOTICE. Local vendoring avoids external runtime dependencies.

Official source: https://github.com/apache/echarts/releases/tag/6.0.0

SSR reference: https://echarts.apache.org/handbook/en/how-to/cross-platform/server/

Release audit 2026-10-16: npm registry metadata for this exact version also declares ISC. The original npm tarball contains no standalone LICENSE file; no copyright holder text has been invented. Metadata: https://registry.npmjs.org/mapvgl/1.0.0-beta.188
